claims: The Artemis II mission is scheduled to splash down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II mission splashdown is scheduled at approximately 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT).
The Orion capsule will carry four astronauts.
The Orion capsule will undergo a fiery re-entry.
The Orion capsule will be recovered by the USS John P. Murtha.
The splashdown location is the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
Live coverage begins at 6:30 p.m. EDT on NASA+, YouTube, and other platforms.
The Artemis II mission concludes a 10-day journey.
The Artemis II mission crew travels around the Moon.
The Artemis II mission is the first crewed flight of the Artemis program
